task.description:
Implement API-09 (Request tracing) per the design artefact at src/design/api-tracing.md.

API-09 requirements:
- Every request assigned a UUID v4 trace_id at request start
- If caller provides X-Trace-Id request header, use that value (propagation)
- X-Trace-Id header included in every response
- trace_id appears in every log entry during that request
- trace_id appears in the trace_id field of any error response body
- Trace ID still assigned/returned even if auth fails (HTTP 401)
- Incoming X-Trace-Id that is not a valid UUID must be accepted as-is

Key implementation tasks (follow design artefact for details):
1. Create src/api/middleware/trace.zig — trace middleware (runs FIRST, before auth)
2. Create src/api/trace_context.zig — thread-local storage for trace ID
3. Modify src/api/errors.zig — add trace_id field to ProblemDetails and error responses
4. Modify src/obs/logger.zig — read trace_context and inject trace_id into each log entry
5. Wire trace middleware into the request chain in src/api/api_mod.zig (as first middleware)

Validate with:
  zig build
  zig build test

Both must exit 0.
acceptance_criteria: src/api/middleware/trace.zig created: generates UUID v4, propagates X-Trace-Id, sets X-Trace-Id on response
src/api/trace_context.zig created: thread-local trace ID storage with get/set/clear
src/api/errors.zig modified: ProblemDetails includes trace_id field, serialized in JSON
src/obs/logger.zig modified: each log entry includes trace_id from trace_context
Trace middleware is first in chain (before auth)

result.summary: Implemented API-09 (Request tracing): created src/api/trace_context.zig (thread-local trace ID store), src/api/middleware/trace.zig (UUID v4 generation + extractOrGenerate), src/obs/logger.zig (structured logger with trace_id injection). Extended src/api/errors.zig ProblemDetails with trace_id field and updated serialise() to include it. Wired trace_context + trace_middleware exports into src/api/api_mod.zig and src/main.zig. Used fillRandom() (OS CSPRNG) in place of removed std.crypto.random (Zig 0.16). Added 10 unit tests in tests/unit/test_api09_tracing.zig and registered in build.zig. zig build and zig build test both exit 0.
